snippet.title: G-Rebels - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
G-Rebels is now available in Early Access on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445980/GRebels/
 
Become an elite combat pilot in a vast open world where high-speed aerial combat, dangerous missions, exploration, and dark conspiracies await. Upgrade your ship, build your reputation, and carve your own path through a living, breathing cyberpunk world.

Join our Discord and help shape the future of G-Rebels:
https://discord.gg/emhZDj95xX

Your feedback matters! Report bugs, suggest new features, discuss balancing, and help us make G-Rebels the best game it can be throughout Early Access. 

Follow us for future updates, and if you enjoy the game, don't forget to leave a Steam review. It really helps support the project!

#GRebels #EarlyAccess #Steam #SciFi #OpenWorld #FlightCombat #SpaceGame #Cyberpunk
